جهل.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: the opposite of knowledge (ignorance); and lightness/agitation, the opposite of calm

جهم.core_meaning_english: indicates the opposite of cheerfulness and openness of countenance (i.e. sternness/grimness)

جهن.core_meaning_english: a single (isolated) word, not a root with multiple branches

جوي.core_meaning_english: a root indicating aversion/dislike of a thing

جوت.core_meaning_english: Jim-Waw-Ta is not a true root; it is merely an imitation of a sound, and sounds are not subject to analogical derivation nor used as a base for it

جوح.core_meaning_english: Jim-Waw-Ha: one core meaning, uprooting/total destruction

جوخ.core_meaning_english: Jim-Waw-Kha is, in the author's view, not a genuine root — part of it is an Arabized loanword and part of it is doubtful; if valid, it denotes a kind of tearing/breaching

جود.core_meaning_english: Jim-Waw-Dal: one core meaning, an outpouring of something and abundance of giving

جور.core_meaning_english: Jim-Waw-Ra: one core meaning, deviation/swerving from the path

جوز.core_meaning_english: Jim-Waw-Zay: two core meanings — cutting/severing something, and the middle/center of something

جوس.core_meaning_english: penetrating/passing through the midst of a thing

جوظ.core_meaning_english: a single root for a blameworthy trait, not something praised

جوف.core_meaning_english: the hollow/interior cavity of a thing

جيا.core_meaning_english: two unrelated words sharing these letters, without a common analogical pattern

جيب.core_meaning_english: a root that may belong to the category of letter-substitution

جيز.core_meaning_english: Its root letter ya derives from waw; already discussed earlier.

جيس.core_meaning_english: Its root letter ya derives from waw; already discussed earlier.

جيش.core_meaning_english: One core meaning: boiling/seething and stirring up.

جيض.core_meaning_english: A rarely-used root indicating a kind of walking/gait.

جاب.core_meaning_english: Two distinct meanings; one indicates earning/acquiring.

جبذ.core_meaning_english: not an independent root; it is a single word with its letters reversed (from جذب)

جبر.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: a kind of greatness, height/loftiness, and rectitude/straightness

جبز.core_meaning_english: not, in the author's view, an independent root

جبل.core_meaning_english: one regular, analogically-consistent core meaning: the gathering/coming-together of a thing in elevation/height

جبن.core_meaning_english: three separate words, none analogically related to the others

جبه.core_meaning_english: one single word, from which other things are then metaphorically likened

جبي.core_meaning_english: to gather/collect water in a basin; also to prostrate (bow down)

جبا.core_meaning_english: to withdraw/shy away from a thing (one of two core meanings; the second, unrelated derivatives, is noted as anomalous below)

جثر.core_meaning_english: a word about which there is doubt/uncertainty (not a clear unified meaning)

جثم.core_meaning_english: the gathering/huddling together of a thing

حد.core_meaning_english: Two core senses: (1) prevention/restraint, (2) the edge/end of a thing.

حذ.core_meaning_english: One core meaning indicating cutting, lightness, and speed; nothing deviates from it.

حر.core_meaning_english: Two core senses for the doubled root ح-ر: (1) that which is the opposite of servitude/slavery and free of fault or deficiency (freedom, fineness/purity); (2) the opposite of cold — heat.

حز.core_meaning_english: A single core meaning: notching/cutting a mark into a thing with an iron tool or otherwise; other usages are derived from it.

حس.core_meaning_english: Two cores: (1) overpowering a thing by killing or otherwise; (2) an imitation of a sound made at pain/grief.

حش.core_meaning_english: One core meaning: a plant or the like that dries out; the word is then extended metaphorically elsewhere while keeping the same sense.

حص.core_meaning_english: three bases: (1) a share/portion, (2) the clarity and settling/establishment of a thing, (3) the departure and diminishing of a thing

حض.core_meaning_english: two bases: (1) urging/inciting toward a thing, (2) a low-lying settled place

حط.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: removing/bringing a thing down from a height

حظ.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: a share/portion and good fortune

حف.core_meaning_english: three bases: (1) a kind of sound, (2) a thing encircling/surrounding another thing, (3) hardship/severity in livelihood

حق.core_meaning_english: One core meaning: the soundness, firmness, and correctness/verified-truth of a thing. Truth (al-haqq) is the opposite of falsehood; every derived branch traces back to this with sound derivation.

حك.core_meaning_english: two things meeting such that each rubs/chafes against the other

حل.core_meaning_english: opening/loosening a thing — all its many branches and issues go back, in the author's view, to this without exception

حم.core_meaning_english: Ha and Mim (as a root) shows variance/divergence, being a root with very many branches. Its bases are: (1) blackness, (2) heat, (3) nearness and presence, (4) a type of sound, (5) intent/aim

حن.core_meaning_english: compassion/tenderness and pity for something, sometimes accompanied by a mournful sound; some (a group of scholars, cited separately by the author) say it can also occur without any sound.

حا.core_meaning_english: ح and أ (together) name a tribe.

حب.core_meaning_english: three core senses: (1) firm attachment/persistence, (2) the grain/seed of a thing that has grains, (3) a description of shortness.

حت.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: the falling/shedding of a thing, such as leaves and the like, and whatever resembles this is subsumed under it

حث.core_meaning_english: two cores: one is urging/inciting toward a thing; the other is the dry withered remains of a thing

حج.core_meaning_english: four cores; the first is intention/purpose — every act of purposeful heading-toward is called 'hajj'

حدر.core_meaning_english: two core senses: descending/falling downward, and fullness/being replete

حدس.core_meaning_english: throwing/casting and swiftness, and things resembling that

حدث.core_meaning_english: a thing coming to be after it had not been

حدج.core_meaning_english: close to 'to encircle/surround a thing' (near the meaning of hadaqa)

حرس.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: one is guarding/protection, the other is a span of time

حرش.core_meaning_english: one single core meaning: a mark/trace and a notching/roughening

حرص.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: splitting/tearing, and greed

حرض.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: a plant, and an indication of going/perishing, ruin, destruction, and weakness and the like

حرف.core_meaning_english: Three core meanings: the edge/border of a thing; deviation/turning away; and the estimating/reckoning of a thing.

حرق.core_meaning_english: Two core meanings: one is the rubbing of one thing against another together with heat/burning (from which many branches derive); the other is a part of the body.

حرم.core_meaning_english: prevention/forbidding and intensification; that which is forbidden, opposite of permitted

حرن.core_meaning_english: one thing clinging/sticking fast to another, scarcely parting from it

حروي.core_meaning_english: three sub-meanings: (1) a kind of heat, (2) nearness/intent, (3) return

حرب.core_meaning_english: Three origins: one is stripping/plundering (of wealth), the second a small creature (the chameleon), the third a part/place of honor in a gathering.

حرث.core_meaning_english: Two differing origins: one is gathering/earning, the other is a thing becoming emaciated/worn down.

حرج.core_meaning_english: One core meaning, the principal sense to which its branches return: the crowding-together and narrowness of a thing.

حرد.core_meaning_english: three bases: intending/aiming, anger, and withdrawing/turning aside

حرذ.core_meaning_english: ḥ-r-dh has no [sound] base and no genuine Arabic usage

حزق.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: the gathering-together/clustering of a thing

حزك.core_meaning_english: ḥ-z-k is a single word Ibn Fāris judges to be from the category of letter-substitution (ibdāl), not an independent base

حزل.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: a thing rising up/elevation

حزم.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: binding a thing tightly and gathering it, a consistently applied pattern

حزن.core_meaning_english: roughness of a thing and severity/harshness in it

حزوي.core_meaning_english: elevation/rising up (a root with few derived words)

حزب.core_meaning_english: the gathering/coming together of a thing

حزر.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: (1) the intensifying/hardening of a thing, (2) a category of acts of judgment/reasoning

حسف.core_meaning_english: something that peels/flakes off another thing and falls away

حسك.core_meaning_english: roughness of a thing; all its derived senses stay within that

حسل.core_meaning_english: one core meaning, sparsely used in speech

حسم.core_meaning_english: cutting something, and severing it from what follows

حسب.core_meaning_english: four distinct meanings, not a single core meaning

حشك.core_meaning_english: the gathering/collecting together of a thing

حشم.core_meaning_english: anger, and something close to it

حشن.core_meaning_english: the spoiling/change (for the worse) of a thing, from the grime/filth that clings to it

حشب.core_meaning_english: close in meaning to the preceding root (حشو); حَوْشَب means big-bellied

حشد.core_meaning_english: close in meaning to the preceding root (gathering together)

حشر.core_meaning_english: close in meaning to the preceding root, with an added sense of driving, dispatching, and setting in motion

حصف.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: firmness/tightness occurring in a thing, along with hardness and strength

حصل.core_meaning_english: one regular/analogical core meaning: the gathering of a thing

حصم.core_meaning_english: a root of few derived words, indicating breaking/snapping in a thing

حصب.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: a kind/type belonging to the parts of the earth (small stones/pebbles), from which other usages are derived

حصد.core_meaning_english: two meanings: cutting/severing something, and making something firm/tight; the two are distinct

حضل.core_meaning_english: a single word, not a true root, not to be analogized upon.

حضي.core_meaning_english: the stirring/kindling of a thing, specifically fire.

حضب.core_meaning_english: Two core meanings: (1) what is used to kindle/stoke fire, (2) a kind of sound.

حضج.core_meaning_english: One core meaning: the baseness/lowness of a thing, its falling, and its departure from the chosen/proper course.

حضر.core_meaning_english: Bringing a thing forth/presenting it, its arrival/presence, and witnessing it — though some usages appear to depart from this while still sharing one root.

حطا.core_meaning_english: a thing sinking/settling low, and being pushed/struck down

حطب.core_meaning_english: fuel/firewood; and what resembles it is figuratively carried onto this meaning

حظل.core_meaning_english: jealousy, and preventing a woman from moving about or acting freely

حفن.core_meaning_english: gathering something in a handful or otherwise

حفي.core_meaning_english: prevention; persistent/thorough questioning; concealment (the opposite of being manifest)

حفت.core_meaning_english: not a true root; little is said under it

حفد.core_meaning_english: indicates lightness/quickness in work, and gathering together

حفر.core_meaning_english: two meanings: (1) digging something out, removing it from below; (2) the first/original state of a matter

حفز.core_meaning_english: denotes urging/pushing forward and what is close to it

حفص.core_meaning_english: not a true root, and no usage under it forms a valid analogy

حفض.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: the falling of a thing and its lightness

حقل.core_meaning_english: land, and what is close/related to it

حقم.core_meaning_english: no core meaning and no branch (i.e. this combination yields no established root-meaning)

حقو.core_meaning_english: a certain part of the body

حقد.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: (1) rancour/grudge; (2) that what is sought is not found

حقط.core_meaning_english: not a genuine (established) root according to the author

حكي.core_meaning_english: firming up/securing a thing by a knot or by affirming/establishing it

حكد.core_meaning_english: a letter-substitution case (not an independent root meaning)

حلم.core_meaning_english: three separate senses: (1) restraint/forbearance (not being hasty), (2) piercing/perforating a thing, (3) seeing a thing in a dream

حلن.core_meaning_english: if the nun is considered an added letter, this is already covered under the root حلو; if the nun is original, the word (حُلاّن) means a young kid/goat — but this is not a root that forms an independent pattern

حلو.core_meaning_english: three senses: (1) sweetness/pleasantness of a thing that draws the soul toward it, (2) making a thing beautiful/adorned, (3) [hamzated form] removing/driving a thing away

حلب.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: drawing out/extracting a thing (as milk is drawn)

حلت.core_meaning_english: Ha-Lam-Ta is not, in my view, a sound single root; a few isolated/unrelated words occur under it

حلج.core_meaning_english: Ha-Lam-Jim is not, in my view, a (sound) root

حلس.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: a thing that clings/stays attached to another thing

حلط.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: striving/exerting effort in a thing, done with an oath or with irritation

حلف.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: staying constantly attached/allied to something

حلق.core_meaning_english: three core meanings for Ha-Lam-Qaf: first, removing hair from the head (extended to other things); second, something round among tools/implements; third, height/elevation

حمد.core_meaning_english: ḥ-m-d is a single word/root indicating the opposite of blame (i.e. praise)

حمر.core_meaning_english: ḥ-m-r is, in the author's view, one base meaning — redness; though it could also be treated as two: this one, and a second denoting a genus of animals (donkeys)

حمز.core_meaning_english: One core meaning: sharpness/pungency in a thing, like tanginess and the like

حمش.core_meaning_english: Two core meanings: one is the kindling/flaring up and agitation of a thing; the second is thinness/fineness

حمص.core_meaning_english: not a root with a valid analogical base; possibly relates to dryness in a thing

حمض.core_meaning_english: a sound single core meaning: a taste/flavor quality (sourness)

حمط.core_meaning_english: not a valid root or branch, no sound usage attested, except something relating to a plant or tree

حمق.core_meaning_english: one core meaning indicating the unsalability/dullness of a thing, and weakness/deficiency; hence humq is deficiency of intellect

حمل.core_meaning_english: one core meaning indicating the lifting/bearing/carrying of a thing

حنب.core_meaning_english: crookedness/bending, same sense as the preceding root

حنر.core_meaning_english: a single word attested only because of a hadith; the sequence noon-then-ra is otherwise almost unknown in Arabic

حنط.core_meaning_english: not a fully productive root for analogical derivation; involves a grain or something resembling one

حنك.core_meaning_english: a bodily organ (the palate/roof of the mouth), with related senses attached to it derivationally

حوب.core_meaning_english: branches into sin, or need/poverty — related senses

حوث.core_meaning_english: a usage that is not a regular, systematic root (non-generative)

حوج.core_meaning_english: being compelled/in need of a thing

حوذ.core_meaning_english: lightness, speed, and briskness/agility in a matter

حور.core_meaning_english: three sub-meanings: (1) colors, (2) returning, (3) a thing revolving/turning around

حوس.core_meaning_english: mingling with a thing and treading/trampling it

حوق.core_meaning_english: close in meaning to the preceding root (encompassing)

حوم.core_meaning_english: circling around a thing, close to the preceding root's meaning

حي.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: (1) opposite of death, i.e. life; (2) shyness/bashfulness, opposite of shamelessness

حيث.core_meaning_english: not a true root — it is a word set for any/every place, an indefinite (vague) particle of place

حيد.core_meaning_english: deviation, swerving from the straight path

حير.core_meaning_english: repeated wavering/going back and forth in a thing

حيز.core_meaning_english: not a true triliteral root — its ي is really a و

حيص.core_meaning_english: swerving away/evading with a twist, in wrongdoing or hesitation

حيط.core_meaning_english: not a true root — its origin (in guarding, care, and 'wall') is really from و

حين.core_meaning_english: time; the base sense, with other uses built on it

حبج.core_meaning_english: Ibn Faris states there is no established core meaning for this root that can be relied upon or branched from

حبر.core_meaning_english: one consistent, regular core meaning: a trace/mark associated with beauty and radiance

حبص.core_meaning_english: not an established root; they claim it has one word

حبض.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: movement, and deficiency/shortfall

حبق.core_meaning_english: not, in the author's view, an established root with a known meaning

حبك.core_meaning_english: a consistent, measurable root meaning: making a thing firm/tight along an extended, regular course

حبل.core_meaning_english: the extension/stretching of a thing, from which the branch meanings are all derived

حبن.core_meaning_english: one core meaning, with two words each carried/likened to the other

حبو.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: nearness and approach

حتر.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: (1) encircling something, going around it; (2) making a thing scant/meager and unappealing

حتا.core_meaning_english: a single word, not a true root-meaning; likely a case of letter-substitution, swapped from kāf

حتم.core_meaning_english: not a true root-meaning in the author's view; most likely another case of tāʾ substituted for kāf, but carrying the sense of making something firm/binding

حتد.core_meaning_english: the settledness and permanence/fixedness of a thing

حتف.core_meaning_english: a single non-generalizable word (no verb is derived from it): al-hatf, plural huṭūf, meaning death/destruction

حثر.core_meaning_english: granulation/clumping in a thing, and coarseness/thickness

حجف.core_meaning_english: A single word with no analogical derivation - it is 'al-hajafa'

حجل.core_meaning_english: A weak/loose common thread - said only tentatively/by possibility that it denotes something encircling/surrounding something else

حجم.core_meaning_english: A single core meaning: a kind of prevention/repelling and turning away.

حجن.core_meaning_english: A single core meaning indicating a bending or inclination.

حجا.core_meaning_english: Two closely related core meanings: (1) a thing's encompassing/surrounding another and clinging to it, and (2) aiming at something and doing it deliberately/intentionally.

خد.core_meaning_english: the erosion/wearing-away of a thing and its extension downward

خر.core_meaning_english: disturbance/commotion and falling accompanied by a sound

خز.core_meaning_english: two meanings: (1) something being fixed/thrust firmly into another, (2) a type/species of animal

خس.core_meaning_english: two meanings: (1) the vileness/lowness of a thing, (2) the rotation/taking-turns over a thing

خص.core_meaning_english: a consistent, regular meaning: it indicates a gap/opening and a breach/notch

خض.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: (1) the scantiness/flimsiness of a thing, (2) agitation/turbulence in a thing accompanied by wetness

خط.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: a mark/trace that extends lengthwise

خف.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: the opposite of heaviness and gravity/weightiness

خق.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: a depression/dent in a thing, and a tear/rent

خل.core_meaning_english: one core meaning whose branches are close together; it properly reduces to either fineness/thinness or a gap/opening

خم.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: one, a change/spoiling of smell; the other, cleaning/purifying something

خن.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: the imitation of a weak/faint sound

خا.core_meaning_english: khā' with a lengthened hamza is not a base to be analogized from; only one usage is mentioned whose soundness is unknown

خب.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: first, a thing extending lengthwise; second, a kind of deceit

خت.core_meaning_english: khā' with tā' is not a true root, because its tā' is a substitution for a sīn

خث.core_meaning_english: khā' with thā' is not a valid root nor a sound derivative to be built upon, but what is reported of it is mentioned nonetheless

خدر.core_meaning_english: two cores: darkness/concealment; and slowness/staying put

خدش.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: scratching/scoring one thing against another

خدع.core_meaning_english: one core meaning, per al-Khalil: concealing/hiding a thing

خدم.core_meaning_english: the encircling/going-around of one thing by another.

خدب.core_meaning_english: two meanings: (1) unsteadiness/looseness combined with softness; (2) tearing/splitting of something.

خذق.core_meaning_english: not a genuine root — contains only a word formed by letter-substitution

خذل.core_meaning_english: forsaking/abandoning a thing and holding back from it

خرز.core_meaning_english: gathering one thing to another and joining it (stringing together)

خرس.core_meaning_english: three distinct senses: (1) a kind of vessel, (2) inability to speak (muteness), (3) a type of food

خرش.core_meaning_english: One core meaning: a swelling/puffing-up in a thing, and perforations/holes

خرص.core_meaning_english: khā'-rā'-ṣād: several roots/senses that are very divergent from one another (not reducible to one core meaning)

خرض.core_meaning_english: Some people claimed that 'khareeḍa' means a young, beautiful girl — but the author states this is not reliable and has no sound analogical basis

خرط.core_meaning_english: One consistent, regularly-derived root meaning the passing away / slipping off of a thing

خرع.core_meaning_english: One core meaning: softness/slackness; other usages are derived from it

خرف.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: one, that a thing is picked/harvested; the other, the road/path

خرق.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: the tearing/rending and piercing-through of a thing; all its branches return to this

خرم.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: a kind of cutting-off/severance

خرج.core_meaning_english: two branches: (1) passing/coming out of a thing (2) a difference/mixing of two colors

خرد.core_meaning_english: guarding/protecting a thing from being touched

خزف.core_meaning_english: the root kh-z-f amounts to nothing (no established meaning)

خزق.core_meaning_english: penetration of a thrown object, and its lodging/quivering in what it struck

خزو.core_meaning_english: two core senses: governing/ruling over, and driving away/disgracing

خزر.core_meaning_english: two bases: one a kind of cooked dish, the other narrowness in a thing

خسف.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: sinking/caving in and disappearing into the ground

خسق.core_meaning_english: not a true root-meaning; the sin here is a substitution for zay, the wording is altered only to shift the meaning slightly

خسل.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: weakness and lowliness/insignificance

خشع.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: humbling/lowering oneself down

خشف.core_meaning_english: obscurity/hiddenness and covering, and what approximates that

خشي.core_meaning_english: fear and fright; metaphor is then built upon it

خصف.core_meaning_english: the gathering/joining of one thing to another

خصل.core_meaning_english: cutting, and a cut-off piece/portion of a thing

خصم.core_meaning_english: two core senses: (1) dispute/contention, (2) the side/edge of a vessel or thing

خصن.core_meaning_english: not a true root; contains only a single word, if authentic

خصي.core_meaning_english: a single word not to be generalized as a productive root, except by extension

خصر.core_meaning_english: two core senses: (1) cold, (2) the middle/waist of a thing

خضع.core_meaning_english: Two core meanings: (1) a lowering/bowing down in a thing; (2) a kind/genus of sound.

خضف.core_meaning_english: not a genuine root, nothing to build on

خضم.core_meaning_english: two meanings: a type of eating/chewing, and abundance/fullness

خضد.core_meaning_english: a consistent single meaning: bending/pliancy in something soft

خضر.core_meaning_english: one straight/consistent core meaning that everything else is built upon (greenness)

خطف.core_meaning_english: one regular, analogically-consistent core meaning: snatching away with quickness/lightness

خطل.core_meaning_english: one core meaning, analogically consistent: looseness/slackness and disorder

خطم.core_meaning_english: indicates the forward-projecting part (a protrusion) that something has

خطوا.core_meaning_english: indicates the exceeding/going-beyond of a thing and departing from it

خطب.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: (1) speech/discourse between two people, (2) a difference/mixture of two colors

خطر.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: (1) worth/standing, (2) agitation and movement

خظي.core_meaning_english: this root has only this one word in its chapter, and it indicates the firmness/compactness of a thing

خفي.core_meaning_english: two contradictory root-meanings: concealment, and manifestation/disclosure

خفر.core_meaning_english: two meanings: shyness/modesty; and (separately) protection/guardianship, or its opposite (breach of it)

خفع.core_meaning_english: something being afflicted/befallen by another due to a harm that occurs

خلو.core_meaning_english: a thing becoming free/emptied of another thing

خلب.core_meaning_english: three core senses: drawing a thing toward oneself; something enveloping/encompassing another thing; and corruption/spoiling in a thing

خلس.core_meaning_english: snatching away and a fleeting flash/glimmer

خلط.core_meaning_english: mixing/mingling — a meaning opposite to (indeed the contrary of) the preceding root (khalasa, purifying)

خلع.core_meaning_english: the separating-off of a thing from what it was enclosed by or upon

خلق.core_meaning_english: two roots: one is the measuring-out/apportioning of a thing, the other is the smoothness of a thing

خمر.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: covering/concealment and mixing done in secrecy

خمس.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: a number — five; a fifth is one part of five

خمش.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: scratching, and what resembles it

خمط.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: (1) being stripped/smoothed bare, (2) dominance/onslaught

خنط.core_meaning_english: not an independent root; a word from the category of letter-substitution (ibdāl)

خوذ.core_meaning_english: not a consistent root pattern; contains a single word whose interpretation is disputed

خور.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: a sound, and weakness

خير.core_meaning_english: inclination and turning toward (something), the base meaning that other usages are built upon

خيص.core_meaning_english: a word shared with the wāw-form of the root (already discussed under al-khulūṣ / purity-extraction sense)

خيط.core_meaning_english: the extension/stretching of a thing in thinness; extended to anything standing/extending upright

خبر.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: (1) knowledge; (2) softness/looseness and abundance

خبز.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: striking/beating something with the hand

خبس.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: taking something by force/overpowering

خبص.core_meaning_english: close in meaning to the preceding root (خبش)

خبط.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: treading on / striking

خبع.core_meaning_english: not a genuine root; the 'ayn here is a substitution for a hamza

خبق.core_meaning_english: a minor/genuine root indicating rising/being elevated (in gait/pace)

خبل.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: corruption/impairment of the limbs

خبن.core_meaning_english: a small single core meaning indicating a grasping/gathering-up and a diminishing/shortening

خبا.core_meaning_english: indicates the concealing/hiding of a thing

ختع.core_meaning_english: indicates plunging in and entering into something that swallows up/conceals the one who enters it

ختل.core_meaning_english: a small root with a single core word: al-khatl (guile/deception)

ختن.core_meaning_english: two (unrelated) words: one is 'circumcising the boy who is at the age for it', with al-khitan being the site of the cut on the male member

ختم.core_meaning_english: a single core meaning: reaching the end/final part of a thing

ختا.core_meaning_english: not a genuine consistent root (weak/irregular root)

خثر.core_meaning_english: thickness/coarseness in a thing combined with looseness/slackness

خثل.core_meaning_english: a single (isolated) word-usage, not a productive analogical root

در.core_meaning_english: generation of one thing from another, and disturbance/agitation in a thing

دس.core_meaning_english: entry of a thing beneath something, in concealment and secrecy

دف.core_meaning_english: two senses: breadth/side of a thing, and speed

دم.core_meaning_english: covering/coating a thing, in the sense of smearing something over it

دح.core_meaning_english: one core meaning indicating expansiveness and spreading out

دخ.core_meaning_english: dal and kha do not form a genuine root with derivable branches, but the Arabs use certain words with these letters

درس.core_meaning_english: One core meaning indicating concealment/hiddenness and effacement/wearing away.

درص.core_meaning_english: Not a root with a pattern that can be analogized or derived from; only isolated reported usages.

درع.core_meaning_english: One core meaning: a garment/article of clothing (armor); other usages are figuratively likened to it.

درق.core_meaning_english: In the author's view, not a root with an established pattern to analogize from; only attested individual words.

درك.core_meaning_english: One core meaning: the catching-up of one thing with another and its reaching it.

درن.core_meaning_english: staleness / age in a thing, together with change of its color

درب.core_meaning_english: to become habituated to a thing and cling/attach to it

درج.core_meaning_english: the passing/going of a thing, and proceeding within a thing

درد.core_meaning_english: a minor root with little to say (limited in scope)

درح.core_meaning_english: a genuine root also; said of a short man: 'dirḥāya', when combined with stoutness

دسم.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: one indicating the stopping/blocking of a thing, the other indicating a thing being smeared with something

دسوا.core_meaning_english: a single core meaning indicating concealment and covering

دسر.core_meaning_english: a single core meaning indicating pushing/thrusting

دعق.core_meaning_english: to leave an effect/mark upon a thing and to trample/subdue it

دعم.core_meaning_english: something that serves as a support/prop and a hold for something else

دعب.core_meaning_english: extension/lengthening in a thing and its spreading out

دعث.core_meaning_english: a single word: ad-da'th, meaning rancor/grudge

دعد.core_meaning_english: not a [meaningful] thing / no established meaning

دعر.core_meaning_english: aversion/dislike and harm; its origin is smoke

دعض.core_meaning_english: not a [meaningful] thing / no established meaning

دعظ.core_meaning_english: not a [meaningful] thing / no established meaning

دغل.core_meaning_english: an obscuring/entangling arising from two things intermingling

دغم.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: one relating to colors, the other the entry of one thing into some receptacle/place

دغر.core_meaning_english: pushing and plunging/forcing into a thing

دغص.core_meaning_english: a term for the flesh/mass that moves atop a camel's knee, called ad-daaghisa (the kneecap flesh)

دغف.core_meaning_english: not a genuine root, though Ibn Duraid claimed 'ad-daghf' means taking a thing excessively

دفل.core_meaning_english: not a genuine root, though the word 'ad-diflaa' (oleander), a type of tree, occurs from it

دفا.core_meaning_english: the opposite of coldness, i.e. warmth

دقل.core_meaning_english: not a true root with a measurable core meaning and no derivational branches

دقس.core_meaning_english: a weak/uncertain root (footnote flags the printed wording itself as uncertain); but they say al-daqsah is a small creature

دقم.core_meaning_english: a genuine root, but limited to a single word

دكع.core_meaning_english: a single word/usage (not a broader analogical root)

دلم.core_meaning_english: length/tallness combined with drooping, in blackness

دلب.core_meaning_english: the letters dal-lam-ba do not constitute [a meaningful root/core meaning]

دلج.core_meaning_english: indicates travel, coming and going — mostly done in secrecy/concealment

دلح.core_meaning_english: indicates walking under a heavy load

دلق.core_meaning_english: the going-out and advancing forth of a thing, applied consistently

دلك.core_meaning_english: the passing/removal of one thing from another, occurring only by rubbing

دمخ.core_meaning_english: not a true root-meaning; دمخ is simply the name of a mountain

دمر.core_meaning_english: entering a house or other place

دمص.core_meaning_english: no established core meaning for this root, according to the author

دمغ.core_meaning_english: a single word that does not branch and no analogy is built on it

دمك.core_meaning_english: two meanings: severity/intensity, and speed; the two sometimes combine

دمل.core_meaning_english: a thing gathering together in softness and ease

دنب.core_meaning_english: no true root meaning; a reported word for 'short man' is judged a substitution (b for m) from the real root د-ن-م

دنس.core_meaning_english: a single word: 'danas' — being smeared/stained with something foul

دنف.core_meaning_english: being on the verge of a thing's passing/disappearance

دنق.core_meaning_english: close in meaning to the preceding root (دنف)

دهش.core_meaning_english: a single word-form not subject to further analogical derivation

دهم.core_meaning_english: the overtaking/covering of a thing in darkness; then broadens to include non-darkness senses as well

دوش.core_meaning_english: a single word with no further branching/derivation

دوك.core_meaning_english: one core meaning indicating pressing/crowding and piling up

دول.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: one indicating a thing shifting/transferring from one place to another, and the other indicating weakness and slackness

دوه.core_meaning_english: not a coherent [derivational] meaning — no real root sense

دير.core_meaning_english: I think it is a form transformed from waw, from 'house/abode' and 'circling/turning around'

ديف.core_meaning_english: not a meaningful root (the letters do not constitute an established core meaning)

ديل.core_meaning_english: not a valid root-pattern (no established core meaning)

دام.core_meaning_english: successive occurrence and piling one thing upon another

داي.core_meaning_english: two senses: one is stealthy stalking/deception; the other a bone joined to its like, likened to other things, and can be of wood

دبج.core_meaning_english: a thing with a beautiful/fine surface

دبح.core_meaning_english: bending/bowing the whole body over a thing so that every part of it inclines over it

دبر.core_meaning_english: The back/end of a thing, and behind it, as opposed to its front; a few words diverge from this.

دبس.core_meaning_english: A pressed/extracted substance of a dull, not-bright color.

دبغ.core_meaning_english: One word/expression: to tan a hide (with three alternate imperfect vowelings).

دبق.core_meaning_english: not a real thing; no unifying sense

دبل.core_meaning_english: gathering/coming-together, and repairing or mending of household property

دبي.core_meaning_english: not a true root with a unifying sense — a single word, later used as a basis for simile

دثر.core_meaning_english: the piling-up and layering of a thing, one part accumulating over another

دثا.core_meaning_english: not an independent root — it results from letter-substitution (of دفيء)

دثن.core_meaning_english: possibly valid usage, but has no established analogical principle

دحر.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: driving away and expulsion

دحز.core_meaning_english: not a real/established meaning (no valid core sense for this root)

دحس.core_meaning_english: one consistent core meaning: one thing infiltrating/interpenetrating another secretly and gently

دحض.core_meaning_english: one core meaning indicating departure/passing away and slipperiness

دحل.core_meaning_english: indicates a cave-like hollow/erosion in something, and a sinking/settling

دحو.core_meaning_english: One core meaning indicating spreading out and leveling/preparing (a surface).

دخس.core_meaning_english: One core meaning indicating compactness/density and burrowing or insinuating oneself into soil or something else.

دخص.core_meaning_english: Same as the preceding root (not an established meaning); mentioned by Ibn Duraid.

دخل.core_meaning_english: A regular, analogically consistent core meaning: entering/penetration.

ددن.core_meaning_english: two unrelated meanings, not one core sense: (1) play/frivolity, (2) habit/custom

دنقش.core_meaning_english: for a man to squint, looking with a narrowed/half-closed eye

ذرح.core_meaning_english: scattering/sprinkling one thing over another, coating it with color

ذقن.core_meaning_english: a single sense (the chin) to which all derivations of this root refer back

ذكا.core_meaning_english: sharpness/intensity and penetration in a thing

ذلف.core_meaning_english: a single, non-generalizable sense: a particular shape of nose

ذمل.core_meaning_english: a single word/meaning denoting a particular kind of gait (of camels)

ذنب.core_meaning_english: three distinct senses: (1) offense/sin, (2) the hind/rear part of a thing, (3) something like a share or portion

ذهب.core_meaning_english: a root indicating beauty/goodliness and freshness/glow

ذهل.core_meaning_english: being distracted/kept away from a thing by fright or something else

ذوب.core_meaning_english: melting (with related/figurative meanings built on it)

ذوق.core_meaning_english: testing/sampling a thing by tasting it

ذود.core_meaning_english: two meanings: (1) driving/repelling a thing away from another; (2) a group/herd of camels

ذيخ.core_meaning_english: a single isolated word with no analogical base

ذيع.core_meaning_english: the manifesting, appearing, and spreading of a thing

ذيف.core_meaning_english: A single word with no analogous pattern: it is "al-dhayafān"

ذيل.core_meaning_english: One consistent, analogically regular core meaning: something that hangs/trails down low around a thing

ذيم.core_meaning_english: A single word, not analogized and not branched into derivatives

ذار.core_meaning_english: One core meaning indicating aversion/avoidance and dislike-driven refusal

ذاب.core_meaning_english: One core meaning indicating lack of settledness/stability, and a thing not keeping to one single direction

ذام.core_meaning_english: One core meaning indicating dislike/aversion and fault or blemish

ذال.core_meaning_english: a root with little recorded usage, but analogically consistent, indicating speed

ذاي.core_meaning_english: indicates a kind/manner of travel or journeying

ذحل.core_meaning_english: indicates retaliation in kind for an offense

ذخر.core_meaning_english: indicates securing/storing something to preserve it

رش.core_meaning_english: one core meaning indicating the scattering/sprinkling of something moist

رص.core_meaning_english: one core meaning indicating the joining of one thing tightly and interlockingly to another

رض.core_meaning_english: one core meaning indicating the pounding/crushing of a thing

رغ.core_meaning_english: a core meaning indicating ease, abundance/comfort, and blessing/luxury

رسف.core_meaning_english: taking short, close steps while walking

رسم.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: a trace/mark left behind, and a manner of travelling/gait

رشف.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: thoroughly/exhaustively sipping up a liquid until nothing is left

رشق.core_meaning_english: throwing/shooting something with an arrow or similar, with lightness/swiftness

رشح.core_meaning_english: moisture/dew that appears/seeps from a thing

رصع.core_meaning_english: the fastening/binding of one thing to another, as if clinging to it

رصغ.core_meaning_english: not an independent root; per al-Khalil, 'ruṣgh' is a dialectal variant of 'rusgh' (the wrist)

رضع.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: drinking milk from the udder or the breast

رضف.core_meaning_english: one core meaning: one thing closing/fitting tightly over another

عفط.core_meaning_english: a small/faint sound, from which other usages are derived

عقص.core_meaning_english: A sound root indicating twisting/coiling in something

عقف.core_meaning_english: A sound root indicating the bending and curving of something

عكم.core_meaning_english: binding/gathering something together into a container

علق.core_meaning_english: for a thing to be suspended/attached to something above it

عمي.core_meaning_english: a single root meaning covering and concealment

عنز.core_meaning_english: two core meanings: (1) withdrawing/moving aside, and (2) a species of animal

عهل.core_meaning_english: freeing/going off, departure, and a lack of settling still
